issues: Missing dependency: backend/app/main.py imports `from PIL import Image` for image validation in the `/receipts` endpoint, but Pillow is not listed in `backend/requirements.txt`. This will cause an ImportError at runtime when a receipt is uploaded.
feedback: Add Pillow to `backend/requirements.txt` (e.g., `Pillow`) or remove/replace the PIL-based image validation to avoid runtime failures during receipt uploads.
